name: dark_cracks2
purpose: Full-bleed background texture for a dark 'anxiety' section of a Japanese landing page (text and cards will be placed on top). Reference look: a mid-dark grey cracked plaster / crumpled paper wall with fine light spiderweb cracks.
subject: flat, uniform mid-dark grey (#6f6f6f) surface that looks like old cracked plaster mixed with crumpled grey paper: many fine, thin, irregular light-grey and white hairline cracks branching like spiderwebs and shattered glass, concentrated in clusters at the top-left, top-right and along both side edges, with subtle cloudy mottling and tiny paper creases elsewhere
composition: cracks clusters near the edges and the top, calmer center area (about 55% of the width in the center is quieter, low contrast) so cards can sit on it; overall brightness even from top to bottom with no light fade at the top; no objects, no text, no people, no frame
style: photographic macro texture, realistic, low-to-medium contrast, cool neutral grey, slight vignette at the corners, high detail
text_rule: Do not render any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark.
